ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in parallelogram $ABCD$, diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$, and point $E$ is the midpoint of $BC$. If $OE = 6\,cm$, what is the length of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a parallelogram, \\
it follows that $AO = CO$, \\
since point E is the midpoint of CB, \\
thus OE is the median of $\triangle ABC$, \\
therefore $AB = 2OE$, \\
since $OE = 6\,cm$, \\
it follows that $AB = \boxed{12cm}$.
